title: Ask the Iron
summary: Tamsin will show a mage of yours how to ask instead of tell. By the Assay's furnace, under the Yards, where everything's hot enough to listen.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards' second floor, the cellars: hold eight waves.

ready: Eight waves under the Yards. Tell Tamsin.
done: Your mages ask the weather now. Tamsin says it's the same as iron, only wetter.
